info.title: ZAP POST Universal API
info.description: ZAP POST automates personalised direct mail campaigns by triggering postcards and letters from customer events and scheduled sends.

post.description: Creates a batch submission in a ZAP POST campaign.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

campaignId.description: The campaign UUID to submit the records against.

submissions[].description: Provide one or more submission records in the array for the /submissions endpoint.
